rows.note: Use this for thin, crisp pieces of fried potato; it is the everyday all-purpose choice for this food.

example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 syu4 pin2 hou2 ceoi3

rows.note: Use this for an electronic microchip or integrated circuit.

example.english: This phone uses a new chip.
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 jung6 zo2 san1 zing1 pin3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a small fragment broken off a solid object.

example.english: A glass chip fell onto the floor.
example.traditional: 一塊玻璃碎片跌咗喺地下。
example.jyutping: jat1 faai3 bo1 lei4 seoi3 pin3 dit3 zo2 hai2 dei6 haa6

rows.note: Use this for a chipped or broken spot, especially on the rim or edge of a cup, plate, or similar object.

example.english: The cup has a chip on the rim, so don't use it anymore.
example.traditional: 隻杯個邊有崩口，唔好再用喇。
example.jyutping: zek3 bui1 go3 bin1 jau5 bang1 hau2 m4 hou2 zoi3 jung6 laa3
